issue.title: Monitor follow-up tests assume pid-fd spawn even when detach_scope uses systemd-run pid files
issue.description: While landing sase-11y.2.1, monitored just check-full pmztzxqgca9a failed inside the pytest test-cost lane with 48 monitor/followup/resume/capacity failures plus completion snapshot drift. The monitor-specific cascade is reproducible outside the monitor and is unrelated to service/supervision/procs config foundations: the focused service regression batch already passed 90 tests, and the failures are in monitor continuation test infrastructure. Fix by making the fake supervisor spawn helpers support both --pid-fd and --pid-file, or force SASE_DETACH_SCOPE_DISABLE in the relevant tests, then rerun the named monitor/fakey follow-up subsets.

task_type_fields.impact: just check-full cannot produce a clean landing signal on current athena for unrelated epics; monitor-continuation tests fail before test-cost budget evaluation, obscuring real landing failures and forcing every land agent to triage the same pid-file fixture mismatch.
task_type_fields.repro: Run .venv/bin/pytest tests/shells/test_followup_vcs_preallocation.py::test_monitor_followup_forwards_recorded_vcs_ref -q on a host where detach_scope selects systemd-run. It fails with IndexError: tuple index out of range in tests/monitor/_followup_fixtures.py::fake_popen because src/sase/procs/spawn.py passes --pid-file and pass_fds=(), while the fixture unconditionally reads pass_fds[0] and writes a --pid-fd payload. The full monitor pmztzxqgca9a showed the broader cascade across monitor follow-up/resume/capacity tests.
